name: Empathy
description: Empathy gives you the ability to heal and aid allies as well as yourself.  Empathy has no offensive powers, but its heals and buffs are unmatched.

powers.name: Healing Aura
powers.description: Healing Aura restores some Hit Points to you and all nearby heroes. Healing Aura is not as potent as Heal Other, but can heal multiple targets at once. Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Heal Other
powers.description: Heals a single targeted ally. You cannot use this power to heal yourself. Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Empathize
powers.description: Form a bond with a target ally to share a fourth of damage. Your shared bond makes your ally more receptive to your aid, increasing the effectiveness of healing and slightly buffing resistance to all damage.

powers.name: Clear Mind
powers.description: Frees an ally from any Disorient, Hold, Sleep, Fear, Confuse and Immobilize effects and leaves them resistant to such effects for a good while. Also, grants target clearer Perception to see hidden foes. Protection will improve with Multiple applications and as you advance in level. Recharge: Fast
powers.shortHelp: Ally +Res(Disorient, Hold, Sleep, Immobilize, Fear, Confuse), +Perception

powers.name: Fortitude
powers.description: Fortitude immensely enhances a single ally's chance to hit, Damage, and Defense to all attacks. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Resurrect
powers.description: Resurrects a fallen ally with full Hit Points and Endurance.  The Resurrected target is left protected from XP Debt for 90 seconds.  Recharge: Very Long

powers.name: Absorb Pain
powers.description: Dramatically heals an ally's wounds. This power has only a tiny Endurance cost, but it requires you to sacrifice some of your Hit Points. Absorbing someone's pain can be quite dramatic, and afterwards you will be briefly unable to heal your own wounds by any means. Recharge: Slow
powers.shortHelp: Ally Strong Heal, Self Moderate DMG(Special)

powers.name: Revitalization Aura
powers.description: The Revitalization Aura dramatically increases the healing and recovery rate of all nearby allies for a limited time.

powers.name: Adrenalin Boost
powers.description: Dramatically increases an ally's Endurance Recovery, Hit Point Regeneration and attack rate for 90 seconds. Also grants the target high resistance to slow effects. Recharge: Very Long
